panel.title: DPIdeck
panel.timeout: The mouse didn't answer in time.
panel.asleep: Mouse is asleep. Move it, then press reload.
panel.dpi-unknown: This mouse stores DPI in a format DPIdeck can't read yet.
panel.dpi-hint: Drag a slider, or type a value from {min} to {max} and press Enter. Click a stage to make it active.

show_lift_off.label: Show lift-off distance
show_lift_off.description: Adds lift-off distance to the settings panel, on mice that have it.

show_debounce.label: Show click debounce
show_debounce.description: Adds click debounce to the settings panel.

show_sleep.label: Show sleep timer
show_sleep.description: Adds how long the mouse waits before sleeping to the settings panel.

show_lighting.label: Show DPI light
show_lighting.description: Adds the DPI light's mode, brightness and speed to the settings panel, on mice that have one.
